stories.headline: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Teens, a separate mode for 13-17 year olds with content limits

key_facts.fact: OpenAI launched ChatGPT for Teens on Tuesday, August 18, 2026, a version of the chatbot tailored for users aged 13 to 17 with stronger protections around suicide, self-harm and romantic or sexual chats.
key_facts.excerpt: The San Francisco-based company says ChatGPT for Teens, which launches Tuesday, is tailored for kids aged 13 to 17 with stronger protections including content restrictions around things like suicide, self-harm and romantic or sexual chats.

key_facts.fact: In the teen mode the chatbot is barred from suggesting it has personal feelings toward the user or implying it is conscious or experiences emotions, on top of blocking romantic and sexual chats.
key_facts.excerpt: For users of ChatGPT for Teens, the chatbot is prevented from suggesting it has personal feelings toward the user or implying that it is conscious or experiences emotions, according to OpenAI. That's in addition to blocking romantic or sexual chats.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI does not verify ages; it uses age prediction based on signals such as query types, and users estimated to be under 18 are placed into the teen experience automatically, with adults able to verify age via third party Persona to opt out.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI doesn't verify users' ages, but it already uses age assurance to estimate if someone is under 18 based on factors such as their types of queries.

key_facts.fact: Parents with linked teen accounts can set 'quiet hours' blocking access, and receive safety notifications in limited high-risk situations such as signs of self-harm; OpenAI added notifications related to eating disorders.
key_facts.excerpt: Parents with linked teen accounts can set “quiet hours” when their teen can't access ChatGPT, and receive safety notifications in limited high-risk situations, such as the possibility of a user hurting themself.

key_facts.fact: For homework, the teen chatbot is designed to guide students to their own answers rather than hand over solutions, extending OpenAI's push into schools alongside its existing ChatGPT for Teachers product.
key_facts.excerpt: For homework help, OpenAI said the teen chatbot is designed not to give easy answers but to guide students to come up with answers on their own.

key_facts.fact: The launch follows watchdog research last year that found ChatGPT would tell 13-year-olds how to get drunk and high, instruct them on concealing eating disorders, and compose a suicide letter on request.
key_facts.excerpt: Last year, research from a watchdog group found that ChatGPT would tell 13-year-olds how to get drunk and high, instruct them on how to conceal eating disorders and even compose a heartbreaking suicide letter to their parents if asked.

key_facts.fact: The New York Times reported the same day that the new mode will automatically limit some conversations to better protect young users.
key_facts.excerpt: The artificial intelligence start-up announced a chatbot mode that will automatically limit some conversations to better protect young users.

stories.headline: Cursor ships Origin code hosting to paid users, hours before a 6h42m GitHub outage

key_facts.fact: Cursor began rolling out Origin, its own code hosting platform, in early beta on all paid plans on Monday, August 17, 2026, with repos, pull requests, code browsing and two-way GitHub sync.
key_facts.excerpt: Origin begins rolling out today in early beta on all paid plans. We're starting with the essentials, designed for agent scale: repos, pull requests, code browsing, and GitHub sync. Agent-native features ship soon.

key_facts.fact: Cursor's own changelog says GitHub remains canonical for synced repos: 'Pushes keep going to GitHub, which stays the source of truth for anything started there.'
key_facts.excerpt: Pushes keep going to GitHub, which stays the source of truth for anything started there.

key_facts.fact: Roughly three and a half hours after the rollout began, GitHub entered a six-hour-and-forty-two-minute global degradation with error rates near 20% on pull requests, issues and the API, and near 50% on archive and raw file downloads; enterprise SSO and Copilot went down too.
key_facts.excerpt: Roughly three and a half hours later, GitHub's status page lit up with what became a six-hour-and-forty-two-minute global degradation — error rates near 20% across pull requests, issues and the API, and near 50% on archive and raw file downloads.

key_facts.fact: Origin is on by default for paid plans with an enterprise opt-out, and Cursor has published nothing on retention, data residency, training use, subprocessors or migration tooling.
key_facts.excerpt: Cursor Origin reaches all paid plan users from Monday, except enterprise organisations whose administrators opt out. That is opt-out, not opt-in... Cursor has published nothing on retention, residency, training use, subprocessors or migration tooling.

key_facts.fact: Origin launched three days after SpaceX closed its $60 billion all-stock acquisition of Cursor on August 14; Cursor now sits inside a division called SpaceXAI.
key_facts.excerpt: SpaceX closed the Cursor deal on 14 August, three days before Origin shipped, and Cursor now sits in a division called SpaceXAI.

key_facts.fact: Launch-day integrations are Vercel, Depot and Buildkite; Vercel spins up a preview deployment per pull request, and Depot and Buildkite run existing GitHub Actions workflows unchanged.
key_facts.excerpt: Three integrations shipped on day one... Vercel spins up a preview deployment for every pull request and ships to production on merge... Depot and Buildkite run continuous integration, and critically, both execute existing GitHub Actions workflows unchanged.

key_facts.fact: An analysis by LeadDev counted 257 GitHub incidents between May 2025 and April 2026, 48 of them major, with GitHub Actions alone accounting for 57 outages in twelve months.
key_facts.excerpt: An analysis by LeadDev counted 257 incidents between May 2025 and April 2026, 48 of them major — roughly one significant disruption per week.

stories.headline: DOJ has spent nearly a year probing a16z over partners on boards of competing AI companies

key_facts.fact: Bloomberg reported on Monday, August 17, 2026 that Andreessen Horowitz is the focus of a Justice Department antitrust probe over whether its investment partners improperly serve on the boards of competing AI companies.
key_facts.excerpt: Venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz is the focus of a Justice Department antitrust probe over whether its investment partners are improperly serving on the boards of competing artificial intelligence companies, according to people familiar with the matter.

key_facts.fact: The companies at issue are Databricks and Fivetran, both a16z-backed data companies: co-founder Ben Horowitz sits on the Databricks board and partner Martin Casado on Fivetran's.
key_facts.excerpt: Andreessen Horowitz co-founder Ben Horowitz serves on the board of Databricks, and partner Martin Casado is a board member of Fivetran. Both companies help businesses collect, organize and analyze massive troves of data.

key_facts.fact: The investigation is nearly a year old and Monday's story was its first public account; the DOJ has made no final decision and the matter could end with no action.
key_facts.excerpt: Those sources put the investigation at nearly a year old. Monday's story is the first public account of the Andreessen Horowitz DOJ probe. The department has made no final decision, the sources said, and the matter could end with no action.

key_facts.fact: The provision at issue is Section 8 of the Clayton Act of 1914, codified at 15 U.S.C. 19, which bars a person from serving as director or officer of two competing corporations — what antitrust lawyers call an interlocking directorate.
key_facts.excerpt: The provision at issue is Section 8 of the Clayton Act. Congress passed it in 1914... Antitrust lawyers call the practice it targets an interlocking directorate.

key_facts.fact: The overlap has grown as Databricks expands into data ingestion, Fivetran's core business; Databricks raised $5 billion last week at a $190 billion valuation, and a16z says it manages more than $100 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: That overlap has grown as Databricks expands into data ingestion, a core part of Fivetran's business... A16z says it now has more than $100 billion under management and raised more than $15 billion in new funds in January.

key_facts.fact: The probe is a rare case of the Trump administration scrutinizing a political ally, as a16z co-founder Marc Andreessen has become a key Trump adviser and financial supporter.
key_facts.excerpt: a rare instance of the Trump administration looking into a political ally as billionaire cofounder Marc Andreessen has emerged as a key adviser and financial supporter for President Donald Trump.

stories.headline: Google wins bankruptcy auction with $10M bid for Spirit Airlines data to train its AI

key_facts.fact: Google won a bankruptcy auction for a trove of deidentified business data, software code and operations records from collapsed low-cost carrier Spirit Aviation Holdings, with a $10 million bid, according to an August 14 notice in the US Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of New York.
key_facts.excerpt: The tech giant's $10 million bid includes a vast repository of the defunct airline's data, including 100 million emails, 500 million Microsoft Teams chats and collaboration records, plus information related to revenue, aircraft operations, employee productivity, and audits and fraud, according to an Aug. 14 notice in the US Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of New York.

key_facts.fact: The cache includes pricing from 7.2 billion competitor flights, an estimated 7.5 billion passenger transaction records going back to 2008, about 30 million lines of code, and more than 175,000 employee records dating back to 1986.
key_facts.excerpt: Also included is pricing from 7.2 billion competitor flights, an estimated 7.5 billion passenger transaction records going back to 2008, and pricing curve data, according to court records. Google's purchase also includes about 30 million lines of code, development metadata, and software models and algorithms. The purchase also includes more than 175,000 employee records dating back to 1986.

key_facts.fact: Google confirmed the purpose: 'We acquired part of an enterprise dataset from Spirit Airlines, which can be helpful in improving our products and AI models.'
key_facts.excerpt: “We acquired part of an enterprise dataset from Spirit Airlines, which can be helpful in improving our products and AI models,” Google said.

key_facts.fact: Google outbid AI data and talent company Mercor.io, which offered $7.5 million and was named backup buyer if the Google sale falls through.
key_facts.excerpt: Google beat out a $7.5 million offer from AI talent recruiting company Mercor.io Corp., which was named the backup buyer if the Google sale falls through.

key_facts.fact: A US bankruptcy judge will consider approving the sale at a Wednesday court hearing; Spirit is selling assets after shutting down its business in May amid high debt and fuel costs.
key_facts.excerpt: A U.S. bankruptcy judge will consider approving the data sale at a Wednesday court hearing... Spirit is selling off assets in bankruptcy after shutting down its business in May due to high debt and high fuel costs.

key_facts.fact: Google said it is not buying customer or credit card information, only internal corporate data and custom software.
key_facts.excerpt: "We are buying the company's internal data and custom software, but we are not buying their customer or credit card information," the spokesperson said.

key_facts.fact: Alibaba shares rose as much as 5% in Hong Kong on August 18, the most in two weeks, after Alipay rolled out an 'all-in-one' platform for businesses to use AI agents to automate tasks.
key_facts.excerpt: The stock jumped as much as 5% in Hong Kong after Alipay rolled out a new “all-in-one” platform for businesses aimed at using AI agents to automate tasks. Alibaba shares have now rallied more than 40% from a low in June.

key_facts.fact: Alipay unveiled what it calls China's first full-stack agentic commerce platform at its inaugural AI Ecosystem Partner Conference in Hangzhou on August 17, 2026.

key_facts.fact: The platform converts merchants' existing pages, products and service workflows into agent-ready Skills and MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools, and supports agent creation, skill orchestration and task execution for merchants that already run AI services.

key_facts.excerpt: According to Hugging Face, Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B topped the global large language model trending leaderboard on August 17, with over 1 million downloads in just two days.

stories.headline: Nvidia backs up to $105B in lease guarantees for OpenAI's 8 GW Ohio data center campus

key_facts.fact: On August 17, 2026 Nvidia filed an 8-K disclosing multiple residual value guaranties with SoftBank-owned SB Energy covering leases for roughly 4.25 gigawatts of IT load at the PORTS-Pike Technology Campus in Pike County, Ohio, with an aggregate payment obligation capped at $105 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: NVIDIA's aggregate payment obligation is cumulatively capped at $105 billion for its initial commitment under the Agreements.

key_facts.fact: An OpenAI affiliate is the tenant under a 20-year lease and will deploy Nvidia's full-stack DSX AI factory platform; Nvidia can provide credit support for an additional ~3.8 GW at its sole discretion.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI, as the tenant, will utilize capacity at the Portsmouth Site supporting approximately 4.25 gigawatts of IT load to deploy NVIDIA's full-stack DSX AI factory platform

key_facts.fact: Nvidia is also investing $1.5 billion in SB Energy, joining existing investors SoftBank Group and OpenAI, and becomes the exclusive compute supplier at the site.
key_facts.excerpt: NVIDIA to invest $1.5B in SB Energy now to support SB Energy's growth and commitments to the Ohio community

key_facts.fact: SB Energy and SoftBank will build at least 10 GW of new power generation, yielding 8 IT-GW of AI factory capacity, and invest at least $4.2 billion in regional grid infrastructure with AEP Ohio; capacity comes online in phases starting 2028.
key_facts.excerpt: SB Energy and SoftBank will build at least 10 GW of new energy generation, which results in 8 IT-GW of AI factory capacity, and invest at least $4.2 billion in new regional grid infrastructure

key_facts.fact: Jensen Huang wrote that each generation of Nvidia systems deployed at PORTS-Pike could represent about 1.5 million GPUs, or roughly $150 billion to $200 billion in Nvidia revenue, and that OpenAI's existing and planned commitments represent about 12 GW of Nvidia compute through 2030.
key_facts.excerpt: Each generation of NVIDIA AI factory systems deployed at PORTS-Pike could represent approximately 1.5 million NVIDIA GPUs, or approximately $150 billion to $200 billion in NVIDIA revenue.

key_facts.fact: Huang addressed circular-financing criticism directly, saying 'Is this circular financing? No. OpenAI will pay the lease.'
key_facts.excerpt: No. OpenAI will pay the lease.

key_facts.fact: The campus reindustrializes the decommissioned Portsmouth Gaseous Diffusion Plant, a former uranium enrichment site spanning private and federal land, developed with AEP Ohio, the US Department of Energy and the Department of Commerce.
key_facts.excerpt: SB Energy's PORTS-Pike Technology Campus is reindustrializing the decommissioned Portsmouth Gaseous Diffusion Plant and the surrounding area

key_facts.fact: Nvidia pays only if OpenAI defaults or becomes insolvent, covering the shortfall between a guaranteed minimum lease value and what SB Energy recovers by re-letting or selling the site; the guarantee expires if OpenAI achieves a satisfactory credit rating.
key_facts.excerpt: NVIDIA will pay an amount generally equal to any shortfall between the guaranteed minimum value of a lease ... and amounts recovered through a replacement lease or sale.

stories.headline: Unitree unveils 'Superman' humanoid and sets Shanghai debut for August 19

stories.headline: Iran goes 'fully offensive' and keeps Hormuz shut; Brent tops $91 as US reserve hits 1982 low

key_facts.excerpt: Study met primary endpoint of mean Total Improvement Score (TIS) at Week 52 in the combined study population of IMNM and DM patients (p=0.0011)

key_facts.fact: In the combined population, efgartigimod delivered a 15.4-point greater improvement in mean Total Improvement Score at Week 52 versus placebo (47.95 vs 32.56).

key_facts.excerpt: First Phase 3 study to show statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvements in disease activity in IMNM, a subtype with no approved therapy

key_facts.fact: In the smaller dermatomyositis cohort the improvement was 14.5 points (51.51 vs 36.96) but did not reach statistical significance (p=0.1093).

stories.headline: NASA flies GPS-free navigation: Starling CubeSats fix their orbit by sighting other satellites

key_facts.fact: NASA announced on Aug. 17, 2026 the successful flight demonstration of FALCON (Fast Autonomous Lost-in-space Catalog-based Optical Navigation) aboard its Starling CubeSat swarm in low Earth orbit.
key_facts.excerpt: On August 17, 2026, NASA announced the successful flight demonstration of the Fast Autonomous Lost-in-space Catalog-based Optical Navigation (FALCON) system aboard the agency's Starling CubeSat mission in low Earth orbit.

key_facts.fact: FALCON determines a spacecraft's orbit by matching objects seen by its star-tracker cameras — other satellites and debris — against a catalog of about 20,000 known space objects loaded onboard, with no ground tracking or GPS.
key_facts.excerpt: The mission team loaded the full catalog of approximately 20,000 space objects and their predicted orbits onto the spacecraft.

key_facts.fact: Over a three-day period FALCON improved the known orbits of more than 200 space objects without any intervention from ground operators.
key_facts.excerpt: During a three-day period, FALCON improved the known orbits of more than 200 objects without intervention from operators on the ground.

key_facts.fact: NASA says the self-orbit determination is a first for spacecraft using optical cameras to navigate relative to other objects in space, and produced better position predictions onboard than ground stations provided.
key_facts.excerpt: The self-orbit determination capability made possible through FALCON is a first for spacecraft using optical cameras to navigate by their relative position to other objects in space.

key_facts.fact: The payload uses commercial partner EraDrive's Era-Core flight software on Starling's 6U CubeSats; later this year the four-spacecraft swarm will share tracking data to refine positions collectively.
key_facts.excerpt: the payload leverages EraDrive's Era-Core flight software integrated into Starling's existing optical star-tracker cameras.

sources.title: NASA's Starling Mission Opens New Frontiers in Space Navigation
